guys, I think there is a serious issue with the current Dota 2 Behaviour System and how it is implemented, I will try to give as much relevant and detailed information as possible to explain why I think so and what can be done in order to change that. I do not use github's issue report system and I am not entirely sure what is the best way to present the issue's details and context so if the information is not presented properly, please explain to me how I can I present it to you in a better way. I will separate the main information into several sections. I also am not sure since technically this topic is covered in multiple such similarly named issues if I should go there instead of writing a new issue and if I should please point me to the correct one to post to. 1. Who am I and why do I think my opinion should be considered seriously? - I am a somewhat long term and consistent player with a lot of Dota 2 games played so you can say I have proper experience and knowledge to somewhat "objectively" explain my opinion why the current Behaviour System does not seem to work correctly. If it matters I am also a constant Dota+ member and I buy most of the extra released content at least at the base level available. - I will not reveal personal details in the post but if a Dota 2 team member would like verification of who I am and if the information I provide is valid, you can contact me and I will share that information. 2. Why do I play Dota 2? - I play Dota 2 because I think it is a great team based online game and I find it or at least found it fun to play (most of the time). It simply has a good gameplay system which is fun and allows for a good way to spend your time and to compete in a battle of wits and experience with and against other players. I prefer and mainly play Turbo mode due to their speed, ability to test different builds and heroes and to get the full potential of any hero easier and also because it lessens the psychological burden of "bad" game due to objectively toxic people like the different kind of griefers. abusers and self saboteurs. 3. What kind of person and player am I? - I am player that wants to have fun, do challenges and genuinely try to win the game. I never have or will grief a game just because I am in a bad mood or want to "punish" innocent people. Although I have to admit that maybe I have "griefed" games depending on what the community and my personal definitions of griefing is. For example is griefing or pinging a griefer objectively griefing. From what I have read technically yes because it somehow "promotes" or "reinforces" the toxic behaviour. Personally I do not agree with this point of view because I do not think it is either morally, objectively or practically correct for several reasons but I am willing to accept it and I have somewhat accepted to agree with that. But here is from where I think part of the problem lies, as far as I know (and if I am wrong please send me a link) there is no actual clear definition of what behaviour or actions can be considered griefing with proper examples. Everything relies on the premise that the players have morality, common sense and would not report out of just feelings alone. Do not get me wrong, I know what should be considered proper but I will present you with an in-game example of a game I played for which I most likely got banned and you be the judge if I was banned for a viable reason. 4. What the problem is? - The main problem is that the current Behaviour System in my opinion is not working properly and even bans people unfairly due to volume of reports rather than an actual valid reason for a ban. I do realise there must be some kind of protection against just mass reporting but it I dont think it is working properly. 5. My previous and current general experience. - I used to be at a constant or nearly constant 10.000 behaviour score and I even had the ability to view Overwatch games and judge them. And after a certain update / point of time which I cant remember or pinpoint accurately (but can probably be determined by looking at the game history). I am not sure how fast exactly but my behaviour score started to fall and I reached "1" after some time. Then I managed to climb to 4.xxx then fell (currently) to "1" again and got another 1 day ban and simply had enough, went to Steam support and they sent me here. Some of initial fall from 10 to 1 in behaviour score might have been "rightfully" earned due to me "griefing" and griefing in a way that can be considered valid for a ban - for example feeding a "Divine Rapier" or something of the sorts after someone objectively griefed me or managed to provoke me enough for me to want to just end the game as fast as possible. I am not claiming I was or am perfect but the amount of games I ever "fed a rapier" or such can probably be counted on a person's hands while I have more than ten thousand Dota 2 games and I have grown wiser to grief in such a way (or grief at all, depending on what you consider griefing). My main point is, I dont even grief in any way at all (at least by my standards which I will explain in more detail below), I try to play the games to the best of my capacity even with griefers in it and still my behaviour score falls a lot faster than it rises and I get bans which from what I have observed basically amounts to lower behaviour score amounting to easier bans due to mass reporting coming from other people at low behaviour score which most likely do it out of spite even if they havent been provoked or griefed. 6. What do the game developers, community and me personally define as griefing? - I do not know either what the developers or other parts of the community deem to be considered griefing but at least I can give you my opinion, behaviour and examples and you can decided for yourself if my point of view is skewed or somehow the general notion of fair and unfair is being skewed. I will give you my opinion on it with examples below. 7. What is currently worst behaviour and can it be / should it be considered as griefing? Here are several things and examples of what can be considered "griefing" done by me, considering by the highest moral standarts (which shouldnt be the highest because such moral standarts are undeserved and simply impractical to execute by a normal player faced with a genuine abuser or griefer and would otherwise amount to basically defending the abuser from any retaliation from a victim and by extension punishing the victim and encouraging the abuser): - I REALLY want to highlight that I (almost) never (like 99,999% of the time) do not start a negative behaviour be it pinging or else towards a team mate, and I am not using this an excuse for negative behaviour, I am saying that if I ever ping items or levels or else it is always in retaliation of someone else that does it or has done it multiple times which in most cases is them falsely pushing blame ( and I do really mean objectively falsely, because I check if it was my fault and if I have done everything in my power considering the situation to help them and check if the blame is genuinely mine. If that is ever the case I either say sorry or keep my mouth shut. - I do not feed rapiers or similar behaviour, maybe in a somewhat recent game in which one invisible team mate simply stayed on the lane without any contribution, leeched xp (thus actively gave our opponent on the lane a level advantage while destroying ours) and did not even help in team fights in front of him I did buy 2-3 Dusts and left them under our tower, I want to clarify that everyone (the enemy or our team) can pick the dusts (including the "afk" team mate) and the dust can be considered a support item given to our team against their so yeah I have walked the "grey" line in this manner and I do not think I should regret it or should be punished for it. - My communication and "pinging", before when I started falling from 10, yes I admit some of that fall the same as the rapier most likely was deserved because I did ping an item multiple times or the similar. And by the way to clarify I dont think I have ever genuinely insulted or abused anyone in chat (at least I dont remember doing so), even though I have had a team of players literally saying they will rape my mother and etc. So consider how fair is that. My current "pinging" which by the highest perfect moral standards can be considered toxic is in retaliation to other people pinging me for either illogical things (for example vision and warding all while I have been warding everywhere the whole game but the person did not pay attention at all and went for the only place the enemy just dewarded) or me seeing how they deflect blame from themselves. And for example because even if I wanted to ping like a madman (which from quite some time I neither want or am interested at all) I cant simply because of the 30 second chat restriction so the worst "chat abuse' or negative behaviour is to ping a "Mantle of Intelligence" 4-5 times during a game, again in most cases either in retaliation but I have to admit it was several times due to the plain stupidity and deflecting of people - for example a Shadowfiend mid that dies several times in a row the same way on an unwarded mid and then he tells someone else or me for example to buy another entirely unrelated or not useful item. And the other thing is probably giving a few mantles to such people when I can already see the game is most likely going to be a loss due to our team being outfarmed, beaten and biting at each other and I still have no way out without being punished for leaving the game and eventually banned because of multiple leavings, so yeah judge me for those mantles as much as you want, it is easy when you are not in my shoes. - So now the interesting and truly grey grey line at least in my eyes, from which I refuse to not "morally" defend my position which I will even give a recent game example below. I guess the ultimate way to never EVER be griefed or reported or reported like 1-10% of the time only due to plain spite would be if you ALWAYS bend over to the demands of your team mates no matter if they have the objective right - be it farm or lane or otherwise. Which in my opinion is simply morally corrupt and sick and I dont think should be considered the right thing, for the very least it truly promotes toxic behaviour because the toxic people get what they want all while other players cant or have to wait a lot of time to play whatever role or hero on whatever lane or way they want which in my opinion goes and should go directly against the spirit of Dota 2 which allows a person (at least not in a ranked and not a "role" based game mode like Turbo) to play whatever and however they want ( with the exception of simply solo feeding multiple times by only their own fault and purposeful griefing by extension of it). 8. My recent game example that convinced me to finally come here and speak my mind. The straw that finally broke the camel's back for me is my last game that got me a 1 day ban and now with 3-5 single draft games I need to win yet again, after I had a ban just 1-2 days prior and just crawled out of the low priority pool just to be sent there again. This game simply removed all self doubt in that the problem might be in me and convinced me that there is something wrong with the current behaviour system. So what happened in the game and did I do anything "objectively" wrong. - Well what happened was that I selected mid first and decided to play a "Crystal Maiden" and yeah, yeah I know what you are thinking - the Maiden isnt a mid hero and even on mid afterwards isnt that useful even in Turbo and yada yada - I know but that isnt the point, the point is that it is a Turbo public uncoordinated game in which not one of the 10 people have any responsibility towards anyone in the game to play a certain way other than just [;ay to win the game. This isnt about what is mechanically right, it is about the freedom of players to play what they want (and I do not mean feed or grief) but simply play what they want to the best extend they can even if it is just for testing or experience, as long as they actually do play the game. And do you think that I invented that idea or the idea of other supports doing that, no and I havent judged or pinged anyone for it even though I have objectively seen it being the main reason for losing a game or reducing the win probability by a large amount. It has the same effect as picking 5 supports or 5 carries on 1 team or doing an "Invisible 1 hp Terrorblade Sunder build" and almost anyone reading this can understand why it is "technically" is a problem but in practice is a right for any player to do as long as they do not purposefully grief the game. By the way I want to clarify, I basically try to play every hero and with different even quite not standard builds and I am not exactly a Crystal Maiden mid spammer, so it is not like I do the same "bad' thing over and over again to lose and get reported. It something I decided to give a chance to, I dont only do "non standard" builds, I think I play the normal builds most of the time and adapt a few items depending on the situation so it is not like I am plain defending going against the game's "best way to play", I just dont think it is objectively right for people to be able to mass report , be it people on the same or enemy team and ban a person due to them playing a certain way or trying a new thing. And I am sure that ultimately that is how the system works at least at 1 behaviour score - if you get too many reports from different people even if you havent griefed the game you simply get banned which is part of why the whole system seems wrong and proves that in the end of the day it is a tool for people to simply report people they dont agree or like even if those people arent wrong or objectively deserving for a ban. And I will below in a moment what I mean exactly. I will explain the whole game to the end because I think the whole context is needed. So what happened - I picked the lane first and the hero, then another person came to mid , there is no way to "roll dice" for the position or determine who gets it fairly so I personally respect the rule of whoever is first and want to play that lane gets it and under these circumstances I think it is objectively the right thing for everyone. And if I ever am the second person for mid I simply move away and do not contest it and I think that is how it is supposed to be done by everyone cause otherwise there is no way to determine it fairly. Then the other person simply did strange things from the start (they were at least by stats an experienced player) - like feeding the enemy, then walking back from base then staying under the tower doing nothing looking like they were completely AFK just to leech XP even when the second player on the enemy side left and there was only 1 person on the enemy side, then I pulled creeps towards this person so they can die and be moved and they moved and simply proved they were there and their intention was to intentionally grief the lane from me, the same thing happened in the jungle and so I responded accordingly - made sure I last hit my creeps on the camp I first came to and I think even 1 time when I passed through them last hitting theirs. I dont think that is griefing or wrong, for the very least they already costed me a lot of my own xp and gold. Then come the team fights and etc, ultimately the person did not help even our other teammates and I think by extension for example of not ulting to help them and etc griefed them. So basically it was 100% sure that they simply griefed the whole game out of spite and in the end I, the person that played and tried to genuinely win the game by doing what generally should be done to win a game like being focused the rest of the time on team fights and warding even while being leeched out of XP and gold, which directly affected my items and the enemy's items which directly affected my ability to play and not countered or countering the enemy's item and ultimately making my hero more useless not just because it is in the "wrong" position but because it has even less from what it needed to have at that point. And in the end we lost (If it matters I still had a better K/D/A than the griefing person) and since I was to blame by the "mob" mentality of my teammates and the power given to them by "the Dota 2 community to regulate itself" I got screwed and banned. And how I know that most of them if not all of them reported me - well if not by the ban itself, it was because during the game 1 teammate was already muted from another game (most likely by being one of those toxic people by default), I had to mute another due to them starting to spam ping me because they simply took the side of the AFK griefer and most likely just reported me and I am almost sure that the rest of the players simply reported me just because I was playing a Maiden on mid no matter if I was griefing or not. So yes, by this simple direct example of possibly many more I can say that the current system needs serious correction because it simply shows the big underlying issue of the whole system - that the core premise of "self regulation" is basically giving the toxic players or envious players a tool to ban an otherwise legit player that mostly did nothing wrong other than defend their position. 9. What I think can and should be done big or small to improve the current behaviour system? - The very least give the ability even for behaviour score 1 muted players to be able to roll for a position on a lane, that will resolve a lot of internal issues. - Detach communication score from behaviour score completely, it is illogical and contra productive to even consider that both things should be tied together in the first place. I guess that is done to simplify the system but it is incredibly detrimental to the point it actively makes the game worse and more toxic for everyone - it does not allow players that have never even abused chat in the first place to be completely muted and being able to communicate to your team in some sort of way better than 1 ping in 30 seconds is important for team play and game play and can literally lead to lost games and even more toxicity - I am sure that there are a lot more than one game but I personally clearly remember one in which I pinged an item the realised that the enemy team is in front of us, could not ping anything, our team got destroyed not knowing the whole enemy team was there and we lost the game. - Improve the current player rating system - Commends basically mean nothing and I think I know why you have done it this way - because of people who swap commends, well I guess the solution is somewhat "simple" - make "swap commends" in profile names or otherwise a bannable offense since it actively ruins the point of positive feedback between players either for the sake of positivity or for the sake of the behaviour system to be able to determine non-toxic from toxic players. I know that because I think I have one of the better game to commend rations amongst the general player base and I have never swap or begged for commends and yet I am here deemed a "toxic" player worthy of a ban. After that I personally do not see a way for people to actively coordinate swapping commends and thus by extension people will respect the commend system a lot more and you will be able to use it to help calibrate the behaviour system. - If not soften the negative then at least empower the positive report system so it isnt so hard to climb up, in some people's eyes this might make the report system less effective due to toxic players having the ability to more easily climb up but I personally do not think that is the case - a truly toxic person will have a lot of a harder time to climb up if they do not stop the purposeful toxic behaviour and a person that can at least control themselves and work with other people will have an easier time and not be stuck with the toxic people which by itself feeds an empowered negative feedback loop that by the current's system's design of weighting negativity a lot more than positivity means that it empowers the reports out of spite and people get punished but cant be rewarded for their normal, positive behaviour even if it outweighs the negative one by a lot more. - Add a basic rule from the sorts of "Whoever picks the lane first or rolls higher gets to play the lane and the position they want and the other person should go otherwhere.", since that would be the fairest way to determine who should have the right to a contested lane or position and add breaking of such a rule towards the severity of the report, for example if a person legitimately was the first on the lane they should be exempted from retaliation from the second person and the second person should be more liable for a punishment. - By enforcing such rules like the above one and eliminating any possible legit contesting of another person's position you can then by extension determine real griefers and people rage baiters from the rest of the community. When such people are eventually manually reviewed - issue more severe warning to those that refused to follow a basic respectable order and if they continue to do so start banning them for 1, 2 months. And also do not punish or punish a lot less severely the people that respond towards another person's unprovoked toxicity (by the way I do not view myself as being a rage baited person, I just think that responding to toxicity in some way is fair and should not be punishable otherwise if you completely ignore a person some people would consider that toxic and that you are griefing by ignoring people, I personally am quite past the rage part, it is just that when you are stuck in a surely losing game in which you know by the items, team K/D/A, coordination and etc of both sides that it is truly a 99% loss and you have nothing better to do because you can neither farm or afk (because you might get the automatic AFK penalty) or do anything else, one of the best past and personally justifiable past times is to respond to the griefer by at least making them feel bad and making them realise that they are the problem. It might not sound right and it is not like I really like it myself but put yourself in my position or most people in my position - what are you supposed to do, you cant concede, you cant afk, you cant do anything except literally pretend that you are playing while just waiting and wanting for the game to end. - Simply add a "Concede" option. I just read a short Chatgpt summary of why there isnt one yet. And with all due respect to you but you are dead wrong and completely backwards. It isnt about "Comebacks Are Always Possible", that sounds cute until you have been subjected to the actual objective reality. The reality that even if "Comebacks Are Always Possible", that "Always" is like 1% and even impossible if there are actual griefes on your team, yes I have also won 4v5 or 3v5 games but that is not the point of all this. Any long enough term player knows that a game can be won even by 1 single player doing the right thing at the right time - for example a ratting Shadow Shaman can win the game. But that would be 1 game out of 1000 in which they lost meanwhile all while they struggled and suffered in all the rest of those 1000 games. And that one win doesnt even fully feel like a win because all the while you won, you also carried the griefers and gave them a free win. The point is that you deliberately stick normal people with genuinely toxic and unhinged people assuming the second either do not exist or the situation is not that bad. Trust me, it is. And you rely on this 1% and excuse all this abuse and toxicity because of that. It is neither fair or right. - Try resetting once or add some kind of annual reset of the behaviour score system. This way if there are any truly undeserving people at the lowest part, they'll probably stay afloat or at least for longer and the truly toxic people will fall again. Although if the system remains exactly the same I have some doubts that it wont simply completely fail again. - Make either a detailed guide or even a simple rule book of what behaviour should be considered griefing and at what point. For example at what point in a Turbo game a "carry" jungling and not helping in team fights should be considered griefing - 1, 2. 3 times? Because I can tell you from my personal experience even 1 time in Turbo is enough to lose the entire game but if we should be justly lenient - if a person does not partake in team fights 3 times all while they have had the ability and resources to do so, that should be considered griefing and should be an "objective" reason for other people to report that person. That is a detailed example and a simple rule book one would be - "whoever picks a lane first gets to play it and pick their own position first". - By the way I want to mention that from what I have seen the "Overwatch" and the penalties given either directly lie to the player or do not tell the full truth, and I know it by the simple fact that I have gotten immediate bans that claimed to be "Overwatch" bans during or after a game I played while I know there is no way for an actual person to have observed and judged the game already in the first place (at least if Overwatch reviews work the same way when I was able to give them). If it is true that it is not so, I dont think it is appropriate to send messages with lies towards the players since it shows an unwillingness to put basic effort for clarity and respect into the in-game ban messaging system. I hope the Dota 2 development team is able to understand how bad things really are and why - a long term, consistent player is starting to consider quitting the game because it is becoming (literally) unplayable. A person that dislikes to write on forums to come here and write such a large post. I think that fixing the behaviour system as quickly as possible is more imperative than even any content update. I hope I managed to list and explain everything properly. If I forgot anything or have another idea I will try to add to it. Description at first #26636 Part 1: On the Toxicity of the Game and the Reporting System Hey guys, after some time, I once again dropped my "politeness" in despair. I wonder when people will finally realize that Dota can be a toxic game. It’s sad for some, but those who’ve already accepted that there are toxic players just mute them and move on. I don’t insult people randomly. But my perspective often offends people so much that I get 3 reports and end up muted for the rest of the game. It wouldn’t be so bad if I could get back my "politeness" score in 10–20 games, but no. For some reason, it just keeps dropping even when I’m asking simple things like: "Тепнись со своего лайна для помощи" "Почему сс не дали у вас же тип с лайна ушел разве это так трудно?" "Зачем ты свой же спот заблочил?" And if I use a trigger word like "Нахуя", people act like it’s the worst thing ever. It’s basically the same as saying "WTF", but apparently, that’s enough for them to mass-report me. It’s not even an insult – it’s just how people talk. But those who’ve been miserable in life, working jobs they hate, find pleasure in reporting someone like me just because I’m not like them (i.e., not dumb) Part 2: On How Simple Phrases Are Perceived When I ask, “А нахуя ты сидишь до меня доебываешься когда я делаю все правильно?” - for example, when I don’t die along with our core or mid - they report me again. That would roughly translate to: "What the fuck are you sitting there messing with me for, when I’m playing correctly?" I’m not even trying to offend people. I just write basic, straightforward things - stuff that some players simply can’t comprehend. Even when I’m with friends trying to teach them the game a little, I see newer players and want to explain: stop feeding the enemy carry, just go jungle or rotate. But I know it’s useless Part 3: On the Toxicity of the Game Itself Dota is a toxic game, no doubt. Maybe it wouldn’t be this way if every action didn’t directly affect the outcome of the game. For example, if you miss a hook, people immediately call you a "долбаеб" (or worse). Even if that hits you emotionally, is it really so hard to press tab and mute that person for yourself? Yes, they might be toxic. Yes, they might be rude. But they could also be saying useful things that might help you now or later. For example, someone might shout, "Ну ты ебаный долбаеб просто дай ульт на зевсе и я дам купол и мы его ебнем!" This is just a rough translation of how it could sound: "u fucking bastard just press ultimate on Zeus and I give chronosphere and we kill him" Part 4: On the Toxicity of the RU Segment Most of the toxic players on the RU server are either men aged 20–40 or trolls who enjoy provoking others with absurd, often nonsensical phrases like: "What u will saying then i give u my dick under ur mouth" "What will u say after sex with animal say it now in VC or text" In Russian, they throw insults that have no exact equivalent in English. Even if people get offended, what’s the problem with muting them? It’s not hard, right? So why should I be forced to suffer because I can’t get my team to group for a teamfight or push a lane, or even do Roshan? Part 5: On the Reporting System Issues I would be so happy if they removed this system from Dota, at least because it interprets trigger words as insults. In the Russian community, saying things like "нахуя тебе", "Похуй мне", "заебал уже", "Отъебись" are common. It’s not that offensive – it’s just how we communicate. You can hear these words in everyday conversations too. But the thing is, many people don’t care, but there are some who know how to exploit the system. They report you for every little thing, even though they might not fully understand the meaning of the sentence For example, if I say: "А нахуя ты это купил ты че ебнулся?" It’s not an insult – it’s a question with a slight tone of mockery about their purchase. This can happen even when someone picks, say, Lich and buys a Rapier as their first item Part 6: The Meaning of the Words I Use Let’s break down some of the words I use: "Нахуя" – "what the fuck" (not an exact match, but close enough) "Похуй" – "never mind" (roughly the same meaning) "Заебал" – "fuck brain" (close to the idea) "Отъебись" – "fuck off" (exactly the same) In reality, it’s really stupid that I have to suffer because of reports from people who are frustrated with life. I have to pretend to be some aristocrat who grew up in a monastery and never used a swear word just because someone reported me, either from my team or the enemy team. It’s frustrating, especially when players use reports as a joke, just spamming them on anyone, hoping it will work Part 7: How the System Should Change Please, remove or change this system to something more reasonable. For example, if a person has a low "politeness" score, they will just be stuck with other toxic players, and they can have their own "insult battles." Let them trash-talk all they want But if you remove voice chat and map pings, you lose the ability to communicate and enjoy the game. It’s like being Mowgli raised by animals - you can’t understand human language and end up just banging your chest like a gorilla when something bothers you. But that doesn't reduce toxicity. Description To put it briefly, the issue is, overall, in the politeness system itself. Dota will never have a fully polite player base - it’s become completely normal to hear insults directed at you in video games, especially in Dota. Well, fine. But after the politeness system was introduced in Dota, people didn’t stop insulting, belittling, or humiliating each other. It’s just incredibly naive to add something like this to a game that was practically built around vulgar communication. Personally, I’ve been getting muted for no reason in my last two games, and I honestly don’t like it. I sit there like a caveman, able to ping only once every 30 seconds. I see an enemy hero - “You can use signals again in 30 seconds.” I don’t understand: am I playing a team game, or a whining simulator for kids under 14? In reality, I can’t even ask someone to press Arcane Boots - because apparently, I don’t have enough politeness points. Do Dota players now need to act like tolerant aristocrats? The game is played by people aged 14 to 40 - most have heard insults before, and the mature ones don’t take them personally. I don’t think I should worry about hurting someone’s feelings by pointing out that their clumsy hands and nasally voice in voice chat won’t get them anywhere in life - that their maximum achievement will be working at McDonald’s, asking for orders through tears. Why should others - and I myself - suffer, just because I pointed out one player’s mistakes and got muted for it? I’ve been playing Dota for a long time, and for the past 2 years, I haven’t been able to communicate with teammates properly - because I get muted for asking in chat, “Why the hell are you buying Battle Fury on Sven?” I don’t know - maybe it’s time to just remove the system, or at least redesign it to be stable and sane. In a team game, I can’t talk to my team, point out mistakes, or ask for a teleport via voice - because I lack “politeness”. If I type “TP MID” in all caps - I get muted. If I don’t type it and die - I get reported, and then muted. Pick Techies or Zeus as a position 5? - Report and mute. Don’t give last pick to mid or carry? - Report and mute. Point out someone’s mistake, even calmly? — Report and mute. Respond to provocation? - The instigator stays unmuted, you get muted. Stay silent to avoid mute? - You still get reported, muted, and insulted anyway. Refuse to help a carry because it’ll get you both killed? - Report and mute. Ask a drunk to shut up? - Report and mute. AFK for more than 3 seconds? - Report and mute. Trying to win by playing Broodmother, Lone Druid, Beastmaster, or Brewmaster? - Report from every enemy player, and a mute too. Ask someone “Are you okay?” - Aggression in response, report and mute. Just delete this system. If people can't handle hearing the truth, let them mute others individually like it was before and play in peace. ### Example Match ID (and possibly Timestamp) 8346471869 - 31:00 ### Screenshots Description # Feedback & Suggestions: Dota 2 Report and Behaviour System The current Dota 2 report and behaviour system feels unfair and easily exploitable, especially for players with behaviour scores below 6,000. Here are the main issues and suggestions: ## Issues Observed - **Difficulty Recovering Behaviour Score:** Once a player drops below 6k behaviour, it becomes nearly impossible to recover, even with consistently positive gameplay. - **Unfair Reporting:** Players often get reported despite carrying games and maintaining good conduct, sometimes simply for being muted or for no clear reason. - **Lack of Action Against Real Trolls:** Players who intentionally ruin games (e.g., staying in the jungle AFK for 20+ minutes in Turbo) rarely get banned, which encourages toxic behaviours. - **Abuse of Reporting:** Many players report anyone who is muted or disagrees with them, regardless of actual behaviour or performance. This creates a cycle of mass reporting. ## Suggestions for Improvement 1. **Limit Reports:** Remove infinite reports; instead, allow only one report per played match. 2. **Restrict Reporting from Toxic Players:** Players who have been recently reported should temporarily lose the ability to report others. 3. **Automate Warnings & Low Priority:** Automatically place players who remain AFK in the jungle or refuse to help their team into low priority after repeated offenses. 4. **Incentivize Cooperation:** Add incentives for positive teamplay and show behavioural/skill improvements after every match. 5. **Preserve Communication:** Do not remove communication entirely; allow players to choose who to mute, as teamwork is essential in Dota 2. 6. **Improve Reporting System Moderation:** The current automated reporting system is unfair. Introduce some form of AI review or at least human moderation to validate reports and prevent abuse. **Summary:** The current system punishes the wrong players and emboldens toxic behaviour. A few targeted changes could make the experience fairer and more enjoyable for everyone. Description Hello dota 2 developers and all participants of this site. I would like to immediately note that this request has been sent to steam support more than once, but due to the peculiarities of their work, and more specifically, the fact that their task is not to help people, but to send bot unsubscribes, I have to contact you on this site. I also need to inform you that my English is not so good, so the appeal will be in two versions, in English and in the original, so that all participants can make the translation themselves. So I would like to discuss one of the most important and oldest issues of dota 2, namely the defective and even malicious reporting system. As you know, the developers have been refusing to fix their unsuitable system for ten years now, once in dota 2, there were no denunciations of users at all, but since this system was introduced, there has been no benefit from it, but only pure harm. This happened because the managers at steam and valve, both before and now, did not want to spend extra money on creating any suitable system, and instead made a primitive report counter, and some time ago, in order to further reduce costs, they installed an even more harmful service of the so-called “patrol”, shifting its direct responsibilities to community members. Let's figure out how this system works for an ordinary member of the dota 2 community. Previously, when there was no system and the first time after the release of dota 2, the community was quite acceptable, this is due to the fact that at first dota 2 was not so easy to get, also because the brand was not yet so widespread, the first members of this community , there were mostly people who transferred from the first version. These were people of an older generation, and if they were young, then at least a little educated, after some time, when dota 2 became available to everyone, the community was immediately flooded with people who began to poison it. These people don’t care about anything other than their egocentrism, and the opportunity to spoil other people, every day they go from match to match and spoil others’ leisure time, everyone who has been in the community for a long time can confirm this, and no attempts by the developers to correct this (it should be noted that what’s wrong They really tried) didn’t help. What did the developers propose to combat violators, so they introduced into dota 2, the most primitive complaint counter, it works on a quantitative principle, that is, the more complaints a person receives, the more guilty the system considers him and, of course, immediately punishes him. If earlier (even before the system), a person could receive punishment if he left the match, now he can receive punishment for anything, literally for everything, even if he did nothing reprehensible. The only criterion for punishment is the number of complaints, the system does not even try to check these complaints (with such developers this will not happen for the next million years), and after numerous requests from people on various forums, the developers added their greatest invention for saving money, “patrol”. It would seem that that’s all, all the issues have now been resolved (as the developers probably thought), but no, everything has worsened. It turns out that now some members of the community are empowered to judge others, this is an interesting micro class system within the community. Some unknown people, not subordinate to anyone, and not controlled by anyone, now have the right to decide whether a person is guilty or not, and keep in mind that these “judges” themselves do not bear any responsibility for their actions, they can hand out fines to people with complete impunity, and no one checks them themselves. This is an interesting question that everyone must answer for themselves, and these same people from the “patrol”, are they so decent, they check complaints as expected, look into each individual case, look for who started the conflict, and whether the complaint is true, how long they spend to decide whether to punish a stranger, whom they don’t care about, or not, or they just hand out fines to people according to their mood, spending a minimum of time on it, asserting themselves at the expense of others and at the same time considering themselves the arbiters of justice. And even that’s not all, as it turned out, in many cases the messages that “after a recent match, the patrol service admitted your guilt” are lies, why do you ask, because steam and valve are standards of decency, they don’t deceive people, so why, such messages come either after some time, this is if there was an inspection, or they come immediately after the end of the match in which the “patrol” found the person guilty. It should be emphasized that the “patrol” service checks the matches in the recording, that is, only after the match ends and the recording is uploaded to the server; moreover, the inspector still needs time to download the match. Here it turns out that the match has not yet ended, and complaints have already been sent to the “patrol”, which entered the match in real time (which has not yet ended), checked the complaints there and issued a punishment, this is how the guys work, everyone is jealous, but in fact this is just nonsense. Of course, no one checks the matches in real time, and the fine is still issued by a defective system. This is how it happens: if a person has received one or two complaints, then after a while, the patrol may check them, or maybe not, and the complaints go into a common piggy bank, when filled, the person receives the same message, supposedly from the “patrol”, but if three or four complaints are received against a person at once, then in this case the system instantly issues a block for half an hour to a day, or maybe more, after which a false message comes about a “patrol” check. At the end of the search block, the person is given a matchmaking restriction, called low priority or in common parlance LP, which generally depends on the initial block, if it lasted half an hour, three hours or so, then 1 restriction, and if more then three or more. Now let's figure out why such fines are issued. As previously stated, any person can receive these restrictions, regardless of whether he is guilty or not. The patrol either does not check complaints at all, or checks at random, but the defective system is designed only to hand out fines, it turns out that ten years later, the same system issues fines simply based on the number of complaints. If a person is in a team of singles, then it is unlikely that everyone else will complain about him (unless this is an egregious case); if a person is in a team consisting of two groups, then the likelihood of receiving a fine increases slightly, and most likely the person will receive a fine for several such matches, as complaints will accumulate, but if a person is thrown into a team with a group of four, then in most cases he will be given a ban immediately after the end of the match. Well, as it seems to you, there is a group of 4 people, they have been playing dota 2 for a week, and they themselves, intentionally or not, are ruining the match, and in the place with them in the team there is another person who, regardless of what, will simply become for them a scapegoat, well, they won’t send complaints against each other, but then a person turns up and let him be the only one who does something in the match, let him drag them along, they don’t care, they will complain about him, and the defective system will issue him a fine. Many, of course, will say “if you don’t like it, go to the rating, there is a search without groups,” well, yes there is, and this rating (which the developers also did in maximum economy mode, and accordingly it is not working) has many of its own problems, and there is still the same system, which, if not for one match, then for several, will still send a person a fine. It turns out that no matter what mode a person goes to, the unified defective reporting system will still give him a fine. Also, in addition to reports of “obstruction,” there are also reports of “toxicity in the chat.” Recently, in dota 2, statistics called “decency” and “politeness” have appeared, the quality of selected matches, the drop of any gifts after the match, and so on depend on the first, the ability to chat mainly depends on the second. This is a rather large topic to fully discuss here, so we will only discuss a few points. First, this is how the system works in the context of text and audio chat, the system still only keeps a count of complaints, but in this case it also records the fact of sending messages in the chat, be it audio chat or text, it does not parse them, that is For the system, it doesn’t matter what kind of message a person sent in the chat, the main thing for it is the very fact of using the chat. It turns out that if a person sent several general messages in a chat, for example, “hello, how are you,” and he received a complaint from others, the system automatically confirms the complaint and issues a fine in the form of a decrease in politeness statistics. If complaints are received about “obstruction,” then the “decency” statistics decreases. Secondly, it should be noted that both statistics are interdependent on each other and cannot differ, that is, if one decreases or increases, the other follows it. The question arises, why make two different statistics, which still remain at the same level relative to each other, the answer is simple: SAVING money by the developers, quickly slap together anyhow and score, and then they don’t care. A number of points immediately arise here; it turns out that for the system (as well as for the developers, they don’t care at all) it doesn’t matter whether a person swears in the chat, but at the same time does his job, or, on the contrary, quietly deliberately ruins the match, for it everything is the same. The result of this approach is that people who like to chat and malicious offenders end up on the same level of decency, well, it doesn’t matter to the developers whether someone wants to chat in the chat or mess up a match, it doesn’t matter to them. Well, thirdly, from the decrease in statistics, as it turned out, even “decency” or “politeness”, a person is given a block to use chat, both audio and text (with a difference of two thousand statistics), that is, a person receives a chat block at the beginning of the match. Because of this blocking, a person cannot communicate with other team members directly, but only send general messages from the chat wheel, moreover, at low levels of statistics, a person cannot use pictures on the map, and cannot even give more than two signal beacons or chat messages every thirty seconds. And here is another question, how should people interact in team multiplayer, without the ability to communicate, moreover, even those people who have a chat cannot use it, in order to avoid getting blocked from this very chat. It turns out to be just a pun, the system is not designed to serve order, but to exclude even the possibility of breaking it, this is how the dota 2 development team works “effectively”, or not at all. Of course, excuse me, but could a normal person develop such a system and, moreover, brag about it so much, on all releases and on all kinds of forums. By the way, as for the “patrol”, it is unknown whether they check complaints about chat abuse or not and how this happens in general, because until recently there was no recording of audio chat, maybe of course something has changed, but one way or another it is unlikely that they approach the issue better than in other cases. Contacting the steam “support” service is useless, this is an even more defective service than the system itself, at least it issues fines like clockwork, but here people cannot answer the request for days, take weeks to return accounts, and that’s almost all they do, perhaps They still issue some kind of refunds, but they advertise themselves as the best service in the world. So, to summarize, a defective reporting system, coupled with an unauthorized “patrol” service and a “support” service, designed for the sole purpose of lining the pockets of developers, shifting the work to the community (and for free), and doing nothing at the same time. Please note that here there is a maximum distancing of developers from users, you will not find a single link or address on the Internet that would help you directly contact at least one of the managers, all this is done so that they do not have to answer for their greed and professional incompetence, because if they became responsible for their actions, they would have to fork out money, and this is unacceptable for them. This is a suggestion from the developers, don’t use chat, take everything for granted, take only support, and leave more money in stores, and if you suddenly need help, don’t worry, an ultra powerful organization will always send you a bot message for any questions, it’s funny, but even at the same time (if suddenly there are robots who will do this), you are still not guaranteed quality matches, and the absence of complaints against you. And this is not even discussing the fines that a defective system issues for turning off the lights, turning off the Internet, shutting down servers (yes, this also happens when the steam server stops working, the system may well issue a fine to users), this also includes cases of inaction during match, well, tell me for whom dota 2 is more important than anything else, if a person has urgent matters, Well, these are the urgent ones that he should now ignore because of dota 2. Each case has its own nuances, and no system will take this into account, then why is it needed at all, especially such a malicious one as from the dota 2 developers, and if there is a “support” service, why doesn’t this service check at least the most egregious cases. By the way, it should also be noted that hundreds, thousands of complaints are received per day, especially in such a rotting community as in dota 2, how do you think the mega “patrol” service copes with such loads? So either half of the community is part of this service, punishing the rest with fines, or this is all a screen covering up a defective system that continues to hand out these same fines. In this case, in three days I was given a one-day fine twice; in both cases, groups were thrown into my team, who themselves ruined the match, and at the same time they themselves sent complaints. It turns out that out of three days, two days on my steam account, search blocking in dota 2, here you have a mega system. Of course, you (the developers) can say that this does not concern you, but in fact this is a failure, not in dota 2, but in its creators. A normal person would hardly want to live in a world where the standard of politeness and decency is Gabe Newell, the developers of dota 2, and unknown people from the community, so maybe you will stop presenting yourself like that. If you do not want to watch your competitors mock the ruins of your dota 2 project, and if you continue to treat people and the community this way, this may happen, then you should return this project to its former glory, if not in a good way intentions, at least out of your greed, because if dota 2 closes, then your feeding trough will no longer exist. The people who suffer in your community because of your system and your inaction, the same people who give you ratings and bring funds to your stores, thanks to which you became millionaires, these people are now abandoning your project in the hundreds, your latest international is proof of this , and if you continue to be inactive, you will have to look for a new free birdhouse, because there are a lot of those who left dota 2 for these reasons. Now, as for my request, I’m tired of being in this cesspool (by the way, we haven’t even discussed the issues of scammers and secondary accounts of which there are a lot in Dota 2), in which impunity and social decay reign, there are many other projects in including ones similar to yours, which are much better than the current dota 2, and yet I would like dota 2 to become what it has been for more than 12 years years ago, because I’ve been in this community for so long.
